description: Tencent Cloud provides OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible access to a scoped set of current language models through its international TokenHub service.
residency_notes: Singapore dispatches globally; Guangzhou dispatches within mainland China. Services cannot be called across regions or sites.
regional_pricing_notes: The international TokenHub portal publishes separate USD prices for Singapore and Guangzhou, with an additional Silicon Valley table for selected models.

sources.notes: International TokenHub API endpoints, authentication, model discovery, and regional restrictions.

verification.notes: International TokenHub catalog, API surface, and USD pricing verified; the text executor is registered, but gateway routing remains disabled pending live API-key smoke testing.
